title: 真题演练 · 名词性从句
hint: 本组题目按本单元语法点与词池生成/匹配;答错后点击「回溯语法课」复习 名词性从句。

questions.q: ___ we will have a picnic depends on the weather.
questions.analysis: 主语从句表示"是否"用 whether。

questions.q: ___ is known to all that the earth goes around the sun.
questions.analysis: it 作形式主语,真正主语是 that 从句。

questions.q: Can you tell me ___ the nearest bank is?
questions.analysis: 宾语从句中 where 引导,表地点。

questions.q: The problem is ___ we can't afford it.
questions.analysis: 表语从句用 that 引导,陈述事实。

questions.q: I wonder ___ she has arrived yet.
questions.analysis: 表示"是否"用 whether,尤其与 yet 连用。

questions.q: 判断对错:I don't know where does he live.
questions.analysis: 应改为:I don't know where he lives.。宾语从句必须用陈述语序。
